name: detectors/tokens-plural-is-a-count
description: A key or header whose name contains 'tokens' (plural) carries a count (usage counters, max_tokens, rate-limit headers) and is left alone; singular 'token' and any other sensitive word in the same name still map, and values keep going through the shape detectors.

steps.input:
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json
X-Ratelimit-Limit-Tokens: 30000
X-Ratelimit-Remaining-Tokens: 29876
X-Ratelimit-Reset-Tokens: 2ms
X-Api-Token: tok_live_7Qx9

{"usage":{"prompt_tokens":12,"completion_tokens":34,"total_tokens":46},"max_tokens":1024,"token":"s3cr3tv4lue","secret_tokens":[5,6],"tokens":"a1b2c3d4-e5f6-4a7b-8c9d-0e1f2a3b4c5d"}

expect.equals:
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json
X-Ratelimit-Limit-Tokens: 30000
X-Ratelimit-Remaining-Tokens: 29876
X-Ratelimit-Reset-Tokens: 2ms
X-Api-Token: [X_API_TOKEN_1]

{"usage":{"prompt_tokens":12,"completion_tokens":34,"total_tokens":46},"max_tokens":1024,"token":"[TOKEN_1]","secret_tokens":["[SECRET_TOKENS_1]","[SECRET_TOKENS_2]"],"tokens":"00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001"}

steps.note: the UUID under the plural key is still mapped by its shape, which is what keeps a credential under a count-shaped key from leaking

expect.equals:
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json
X-Ratelimit-Limit-Tokens: 30000
X-Ratelimit-Remaining-Tokens: 29876
X-Ratelimit-Reset-Tokens: 2ms
X-Api-Token: tok_live_7Qx9

{"usage":{"prompt_tokens":12,"completion_tokens":34,"total_tokens":46},"max_tokens":1024,"token":"s3cr3tv4lue","secret_tokens":["5","6"],"tokens":"a1b2c3d4-e5f6-4a7b-8c9d-0e1f2a3b4c5d"}

steps.note: numeric secrets come back quoted, as in json-numeric-sensitive; the counts were never touched so they stay numbers
